account.question: Do I need an account to book?
account.answer: No. You book without an account. You can create one after your booking if you wish.

languages.question: Which languages is the service provided in?
languages.answer: English and French: the website, the booking emails and your exchanges with your driver.

validation.question: How is my booking confirmed?
validation.answer: One of the two partners reviews each request and accepts or declines it. You are informed by email.

payment.question: Is payment secure?
payment.answer: Yes. Payment is handled by Stripe and your card details are never stored by us. Your card is saved when you make the request and is only charged once the booking is accepted.
